name: A level only completes with her beside you
body: Dean: finishing the level has to need the companion with the player. The goal only fires when the partner (or the scripted companion) is within TOGETHER_DISTANCE of the player; otherwise the hint says to wait for her or go back for her.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the prototype rooms and the crossing (#107, #108).

acceptance_criteria: Reaching the goal alone does nothing but show a hint
With her beside you the level completes as before
